definitions.explanation: Deep, focused thought directed at a spiritual or philosophical subject, especially as a form of Buddhist or religious practice.

examples.japanese: ⟦{静|しず}か→静か：00755_shizuka⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{観想|かんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧。
examples.english: To quietly immerse oneself in contemplation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{僧侶|そうりょ}→僧侶：11529_souryo⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{仏|ほとけ}→仏：03722_hotoke⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿|すがた}→姿：03363_sugata⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{描|えが}き→描く：02013_egaku⟧{観想|かんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}った→行う：01238_okonau⟧。
examples.english: The monk visualized the figure of the Buddha and practiced contemplation.

examples.japanese: {観想|かんそう}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{単|たん}なる→単なる：01757_tannaru⟧⟦{思索|しさく}→思索：15686_shisaku⟧⟦ではなく→ではなく：09578_dehanaku⟧、⟦{対象|たいしょう}→対象：03393_taishou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{心|こころ}→心：01321_kokoro⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{中|なか}→中：00654_naka⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{鮮明|せんめい}→鮮明：14686_senmei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{思|おも}い{描|えが}く→思い描く：12573_omoiegaku⟧こと⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な⟦{真理|しんり}→真理：03333_shinri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{近|ちか}づこう→近づく：01958_chikazuku⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{修行|しゅぎょう}→修行：05522_shugyou⟧⟦である→である：09855_dearu⟧。
examples.english: Contemplation is not mere thinking — it is a spiritual practice of vividly visualizing an object in the mind in order to approach spiritual truth.

notes:
A compound of {観|かん} (to perceive/contemplate) and {想|そう} (to think/imagine). In Buddhist practice, {観想|かんそう} refers specifically to the meditation technique of visualizing a sacred image, deity, or concept in one's mind. It is a central practice in esoteric Buddhism ({密教|みっきょう}).

Not to be confused with the homophones ⟦{感想|かんそう}→感想：00450_kansou⟧ (impression/thoughts about something), ⟦{乾燥|かんそう}→乾燥：00184_kansou⟧ (dryness), or ⟦{完走|かんそう}→完走：16981_kansou⟧ (completing a race). The suru-verb form {観想|かんそう}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ means "to contemplate."

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {観想|かんそう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦ふける→ふける：09960_fukeru⟧: to be absorbed in contemplation
- {観想|かんそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{行|おこな}う→行う：01238_okonau⟧: to practice contemplation
- {観想|かんそう}⟦{的|てき}→〜的：09839_teki⟧: contemplative

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{瞑想|めいそう}→瞑想：13660_meisou⟧: meditation (broader term, includes mindfulness practices)
- {黙想|もくそう}: silent meditation; silent reflection
- ⟦{思索|しさく}→思索：15686_shisaku⟧: speculation; deep thought (philosophical rather than religious)
